transition_law: Never overwrite provenance or history to make old data look current.
Every successor names predecessors; supersession is semantic/evidence based, not filename based.
Any changed authority, model/tokenizer/ABI, labeler, split, leakage result, target architecture or causal evidence triggers re-audit.
No D/E transition row is train-admissible unless its target is derived by a versioned executable reference evaluator or exact admitted evidence.
No pre-Hyperposition flat integrated family becomes native by appending metadata/prose.
Every exact triggerwort 2 re-audits this registry and searches for unregistered train-relevant artifacts before generating volume.
